answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a non-refundable proof-of-work escrow. Each new identity must burn computation whose receipt peers verify before it may quote prices or vote. One GPU-hour is nothing, but ten thousand is a canyon of electricity a fabricator cannot hide. Trust, like a lotus opening only in clean water, unfolds after that escrow clears, climbing toward a zenith a rushed clone army cannot fake. Adding another face never adds savings, only one more full unit of burned spend, so the attack stays linear in money. That kills cheap identity farming.
